2997.title: No-service reinstall exits without a daemon
2997.rootCauseOneLine: The existing-enrollment branch skips daemon launch, while the no-service branch exits without another process source.
2997.proposedFix: Start the regular host daemon with persisted credentials when service setup is skipped for an existing enrollment.
2997.caveats: The reproduction uses the installer test harness and a local mock daemon. It does not contact a live server.
